label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_VERSION.note: TEST version stamp for the pool overview. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_WHAT.note: TEST sentence for what the pool is. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_COIN.note: TEST coin name. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_HARDWARE.note: TEST hardware line. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_REVENUE_SPLIT.value: TEST in proportion to accepted work
MINING_OVERVIEW_REVENUE_SPLIT.note: TEST revenue-split sentence. Not a product default.

MINING_OVERVIEW_NOT_SUPPORTED.note: TEST unsupported line. Not a product default.

MINING_POOL_HOST.note: TEST pool host a miner copies: the local stack's own miner door on loopback, so a TEST rig dials the address the room shows. Not a product default.

MINING_POOL_PORT.note: TEST pool port a miner copies: the miner door's TEST listen port. Not a product default.

MINING_POOL_SECURE_URL.note: TEST secure URL, published only in this profile.

MINING_WORKER_NAME_PATTERN.note: TEST worker-name pattern. Not a product default.

MINING_PROBE_LIMIT.note: TEST reachability presses one account may make in the window.

MINING_PROBE_WINDOW_MS.note: TEST reachability window. Not a product default.

MINING_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.note: TEST how long one reachability press waits. Not a product default.

MINING_POW_DIMENSION.note: TEST matrix size of the pool's reference proof-of-work check, testnet only. Not the token's live proof of work and not a product default.

MINING_POW_TARGET_BITS.note: TEST leading zero bits a share's work must have, small so a TEST submitter finds a nonce at once. Not a product default.

MINING_POW_TESTNET.note: TEST testnet flag: testnet windows earn no credit. Mainnet refuses audit.external. Not a product default.

MINING_STRATUM_LISTEN_PORT.note: TEST port the pool's miner door listens on, the same as the TEST port a miner copies. Not a product default.

MINING_STRATUM_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: TEST length of one miner-door share window (seven days), so a journey's shares land in one window. Not a product default.

MINING_STRATUM_ASSET_ID.note: TEST asset a miner-door window is mined for. Not a product default.

MINING_WORKER_QUIET_SECONDS.note: TEST seconds without an accepted share before a worker reads offline, short so a journey sees a worker go quiet (J-more-catalogue-06 #4, #6). Not a product default.

MINING_WORKER_EVALUATE_SECONDS.note: TEST how often the pool's worker evaluator looks for quiet workers and records their state changes. Not a product default.
